profile: Bright Memory: Infinite Android v1.34 - Minimal Experimental

settings.label: Resolution Controller
settings.integration: Use the game's existing GameUserSettings resolution-scale path; preserve panel resolution, aspect ratio, orientation and Android DPI.
settings.status: runtime path identified in libUE4.so; UI and runtime binding still require engine integration and device validation

settings.label: Graphics Quality
settings.integration: Each tier applies UE4 overall scalability (Low..Ultra map to 0..4; Extreme is Epic plus bounded mobile overrides), then attempts view distance, mip bias, effects, post-process, anisotropic filtering, shadows and mobile AO CVars. The runtime logs how many of the seven optional CVars actually exist. Extreme never sends unsupported scalability quality value 5 or effects quality 4.
settings.status: Runtime mapping corrected and source-checked: six distinct bounded profiles; optional CVar presence is reported. Actual visual impact and per-setting support still require target-engine build and in-game A/B validation; unavailable CVars are not claimed to work.

settings.label: Render Scale
settings.integration: Manual render-resolution percentage through the game's existing UGameUserSettings::SetResolutionScaleValueEx path. Resolution Controller remains the separate output/mobile-content scale control. Selecting an Upscale Preset applies its recommended render percentage to this same Render Scale value; moving Render Scale afterward overrides the preset percentage without changing the selected preset label.
settings.status: existing Blueprint API and runtime command are present in source; unified preset/manual slider ownership is now specified; runtime compilation and on-device validation pending

settings.label: Upscaling
settings.integration: Qualcomm SGSR1 UE4.27 plugin and shader pass in the game's actual renderer.
settings.status: source vendored; registration and Android shader compilation in shipped renderer are not yet verified

settings.label: Upscale Sharpness
settings.status: must bind to the real SGSR1 shader parameter

settings.label: Upscale Preset
settings.status: must map to SGSR1-supported render fractions and parameters; do not add a second independent render-scale control

settings.label: AMD CAS
settings.status: unavailable until a real CAS RDG shader pass is registered after SGSR1

settings.label: CAS Sharpness
settings.status: bind only to the real CAS pass; disabled while CAS backend is unavailable

settings.label: Low Latency

status.On: available; sets r.OneFrameThreadLag=0; reduces Game Thread lead but can cost throughput
status.Ultra: disabled; the requested zero-queued-frame mode is not honestly implementable through a generic UE4 OpenGL ES CVar. Do not expose it as working until the Android GLES swap/presentation path can prove zero pending frames without glFinish or a fake RHI bypass.

settings.integration: Off restores r.OneFrameThreadLag=1. On sets r.OneFrameThreadLag=0. Ultra means true zero pending frames in the Android GLES presentation path (not merely disabling UE thread lead); it stays disabled until the active EGL swap/driver queue is controlled and measured.

settings.label: Frame Generation Method
settings.integration: Select one independent backend. Qualcomm AFME is a vendor-specific GLES extension; GLES Motion Reprojection is a portable GLSL ES 3.0 shader prototype. Both remain unavailable until their complete renderer/presentation backend registers capability flags.

status.Qualcomm AFME: x2-only candidate; requires GL_QCOM_frame_extrapolation, verified driver support and UE4.27 renderer integration
status.GLES Motion Reprojection: experimental portable shader source added; renderer velocity input, disocclusion handling, RDG/RHI integration and presentation scheduler are not implemented or validated; see engine-extension/renderer/GLES-FRAME-REPROJECTION.md

backends.Qualcomm AFME: separate vendor-specific backend; do not assume support on Adreno 610

settings.label: Frame Generation Multiplier
settings.integration: Select generated-frame count relative to each genuine source frame. GLES reprojection phases: x2=0.5; x3=1/3 and 2/3; x4=1/4, 1/2 and 3/4. AFME 1.0 supports x2 only.

status.x2: candidate for AFME or GLES; disabled until the selected backend is fully registered
status.x3: GLES backend only; requires two generated outputs and a validated presentation schedule
status.x4: GLES backend only; requires three generated outputs and a validated presentation schedule

safety_rules: never show an option as working when its backend is not registered and validated
do not substitute tonemapper sharpening for AMD CAS
do not fake frame generation by repeating or blending identical frames
keep the original game rendering path as fallback

Resolution Controller changes mobile content/output scale only; Render Scale controls the internal render percentage; Upscale Preset sets a recommended Render Scale value, and manual Render Scale edits override that percentage.
Graphics Quality tiers must only claim effects from CVars present in the target build; report missing CVars and validate visual changes on-device.
Low Latency Ultra means zero pending presentation frames; never simulate it with glFinish, r.RHICmdBypass, or a Vulkan-only CVar.
build_status: GLES Motion Reprojection GLSL ES 3.0 prototype and integration contract added; both frame-generation backends remain fail-closed pending UE4.27 renderer integration, build and device validation.

ui_integration.status: The cooked v1.34 UMG assets were extracted and their widget references inspected. Runtime Blueprint-callable API exists for every setting below, but the cooked widget graph has not been edited or rebound. Do not claim the in-game controls are connected until the UMG graph is rebuilt with the project's matching UE4.27.2 editor and verified in-game.
